name: Bao Quoc Pagoda

summary: Enter the triple gate at Báo Quốc, 17 Bảo Quốc street in Thuận Hóa ward, on Hàm Long hill. The temple directory opens the gate from 07:00 to 17:00 and dates the sắc tứ to 1747, under Nguyễn Phúc Khoát. A fee is Check on arrival. How long to stay is Check on arrival.

notice.title: Hours from one directory
notice.body: chuahue.vn prints 07:00–17:00 and a suggested stay of 30–90 minutes. That suggestion is not a measured visit. No second hours source was found on 21 October 2026. A fee is Check on arrival, and the directory’s free flag is not treated as a ticket rule.

body: The Hue pagoda directory places Báo Quốc at 17 đường Bảo Quốc, phường Thuận Hóa, on Hàm Long hill. The old name is Hàm Long Thiên Thọ Tự. Zen master Giác Phong is the founder the directory names. It says the temple history does not give an exact year in the late 17th century. In 1747, under chúa Nguyễn Phúc Khoát, the temple received the sắc tứ and the name Báo Quốc.
The directory prints opening hours of 07:00–17:00. Confirm that board. The 30–90 minute line on the same page is a suggestion, so the time on site stays Check on arrival. A fee is Check on arrival.
The ride from the south bank has no published minute count. A blog that moves the pagoda to phường Đúc is not the address used here.
